q: The pupil controls the amount of light energy entering the eye. (2025)
e: The iris controls the amount of light energy entering the eye by controlling the size of the pupil.

q: The human eye is very similar to a camera in many aspects. (2025)
e: The human eye and camera share similar structural components and optical working principles.

q: One of the unique properties of a laser beam is coherence. (2025)
e: Laser light is highly coherent, meaning its light waves are all in phase with each other.

q: The shutter speed is expressed in terms of the exposure time. (2025)
e: Shutter speed directly determines the length of exposure time light hits the sensor or film.

q: The retina is the light sensitive area of the cells, at the front of the eye. (2026)
e: The retina is located at the back interior surface of the eye, not the front.

q: In the terrestrial telescope a convex lens is used as an eyepiece to produce an erect final image. (2026)
e: An intermediate erecting lens system is required between the objective and eyepiece to produce an erect final image.
